The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-dimensional arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or `optimization.model_snapshot_index`. For an array with a flat object index of `(period, timestep)` tuples and matching auxiliary coordinates, this restores a MultiIndex before conversion to pandas, whereas the base implementation leaves the flat index unchanged. Thus the same input can produce a differently indexed result even under legacy semantics with the default or `"multiindex"` option.
